The '''Senate Investigative Committee''', or '''Senate Investigatory Committee''', was a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] committee, presumably overseeing Senate investigations. The only known [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] was [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Connus Trell]], who was eliminated by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] after he was implicated in a [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] scheme.
